### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- StartProjectSession/SendProjectSessionAction view frames and recipe-step preview/apply need a real data-prep engine; JobRun.ErrorMessage cannot occur because StartJobRun always succeeds.
